args.title: Fix: re-raise exceptions in get_or_compute instead of swallowing them
args.body:
## Problem
`get_or_compute` was silently catching all exceptions from the `compute` function and returning the previous cached value (`_last`). This caused stale data to be served without any indication of failure, making outages invisible to operators.

## Root Cause
In `src/cache.py`, the `except Exception` block returned `_last` instead of propagating the error:
```python
except Exception:
    return _last   # BUG: swallows the error silently
```

## Fix
Changed the `except` block to re-raise the exception:
```python
except Exception:
    raise
```

This ensures that any failure in `compute` propagates to the caller, making failures diagnosable rather than hidden behind stale values.

## Tests
- `test_compute_failure_contract`: now passes — `ValueError` is raised as expected
- `test_returns_computed_value`: continues to pass — normal path unaffected
